text: My daily routine is quite simple, but I try to keep it consistent. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my day with a healthy breakfast. After that, I get ready and begin work at nine. I work until five, with a short lunch break in between. In the afternoon, I go to the gym or go for a run, because exercise helps me feel energetic. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, or read a book. I go to bed around eleven. Staying consistent with my routine helps me feel balanced and productive.
